pages.title: 10 - Magical Automation
pages.description: Ars Nouveau supports  a wide variety of  automation methods  via Spell Turrets,  magical helpers, and  Rituals.   Using one or a  combination of these  options can achieve  almost anything you  want such as farming  crops and trees,  quarrying the earth,
crafting and  transporting items,  smelting, and  brewing potions.
